summary: This configuration file defines a list of email address patterns that should be filtered or blocked by a Sieve mail filter. The patterns match emails from certain country-code domains (India and Russia), as well as common newsletter sender addresses across any domain.

explanations.3: The asterisk is a wildcard meaning 'anything', so '*.india' matches any email address ending in .india, like spam@example.india
explanations.6: This pattern matches any email sent TO a newsletter address at any domain, like incoming@newsletter.example.com
explanations.7: This matches emails FROM an address called 'newsletter' at any domain, like newsletter@example.com, which is a common pattern for marketing emails
